_doc: Hand fixes read by scripts/integrate.py on every run, so re-integration keeps them. Sections and semantics are documented at the top of the 'hand-fix overrides' block in integrate.py. Verify with: python3 -I scripts/integrate.py --check-overrides (reads only). Keys starting with '_' are comments. Every entry is logged in work/atlas-fixes-guides-log.md or work/boundary-sweep-log.md.

parent._why_nz: IPONZ: New Zealand, North Island and South Island are national/island GIs containing the regions; point-in-polygon of their approximate points gave Marlborough/Hawke's Bay (atlas-fixes-guides-log, item 12)
parent._why_waitaki: Waitaki Valley North Otago is its own Region GI on the Canterbury/Otago boundary, not part of Canterbury (atlas-fixes-guides-log, item 12)
parent._why_wild_horse: TTB polygon lies 34.1% in Napa Valley and 65.9% in Solano County Green Valley, 100% in North Coast; SPEC >= 85% rule gives North Coast (atlas-fixes-guides-log, item 12)

ctx._why: ctx values set by hand on 31 Oct (atlas-fixes-guides-log, items 12, 15, 17)

profile._why: Tours-sur-Marne is a Vallée de la Marne grand cru, not Montagne de Reims (atlas-fixes-guides-log, item 15); also fixed at source in depth_champagne_crus.json

alt_remove._why: The Anjou DGC's alt/match 'Saint-Aubin' resolved Burgundy's 'Saint-Aubin' region-list entry to it (followups 11 and 21)

region_exclude._why: Belt and braces for the Layon/Saint-Aubin homonym (followups 11 and 21)

outline_clip._why: fr-cotes-du-rhone covers the whole valley up to Vienne; the Southern Rhone outline keeps only its part south of 44.6 N (atlas-fixes-guides-log, item 18)

EU layer joined 'Marano' to Marano Vicentino (VI); the Garda DOC disciplinare (art. 3) lists 'Marano' and 'Rivoli' among the province of Verona comuni, i.e. Marano di Valpolicella and Rivoli Veronese (Rivoli TO was dropped on 31 Oct); added: Marano di Valpolicella (023046), Rivoli Veronese (023062) (GISCO LAU 2021, simplified 40 m)
Skradin (Sibenik-Knin) is a vinogorje of podregija Sjeverna Dalmacija, not Hrvatsko primorje (Pravilnik o zemljopisnim podrucjima uzgoja vinove loze, NN 76/2019)

EU layer joined 'K. Poroy' to Poros on Lefkada (LAU 36010307); the Mavrodafni of Kefalonia zone means Poros on Kefalonia (LAU 35010209, already in Moschatos Kefallinias); added: Κοινότητα Πόρου (35010209) (GISCO LAU 2021, simplified 40 m)

EU layer joined 'Belusice' twice: Belusice u Mostu (Litomericka, correct per vyhlaska 80/2018) and Belusice near Kolin (533190, not a vinarska obec); the part holding Konarovice + Belusice (Kolin) is replaced by Konarovice alone; added: Konárovice (533394) (GISCO LAU 2021, simplified 40 m)

EU layer joined 'Langscheid' to Langscheid near Mayen (Eifel, LAU 07137061); the Mittelrhein Langscheid is the Gemarkung of Oberwesel holding the Einzellage Langscheider Hundert, already covered by Oberwesel
